FitnessTracker.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object by storing the provided height, weight, age, and sex values and setting a fixed BMI standard lookup table for male and female ranges." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> height </REF>: any "Height value to store on the object."
        <REF> weight </REF>: any "Weight value to store on the object."
        <REF> age </REF>: any "Age value to store on the object."
        <REF> sex </REF>: any "Sex value to store on the object."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: None "No return value; initializes instance attributes."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the input height value directly to the instance attribute height. RESULT self.height]
            [COMMAND Assign the input weight value directly to the instance attribute weight. RESULT self.weight]
            [COMMAND Assign the input age value directly to the instance attribute age. RESULT self.age]
            [COMMAND Assign the input sex value directly to the instance attribute sex. RESULT self.sex]
            [COMMAND Initialize the instance attribute BMI_std with a fixed list containing the male BMI range [20, 25] and the female BMI range [19, 24]. RESULT self.BMI_std]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
FitnessTracker.get_BMI:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the body mass index by dividing self.weight by self.height squared." get_BMI]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Object instance providing weight and height fields."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The computed BMI value from weight divided by height squared."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read self.weight as the numerator value. RESULT weight]
            [COMMAND Read self.height and square it to produce the denominator value. RESULT height_squared]
            [COMMAND Divide weight by height_squared and return the computed value immediately. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: self.height is zero, causing division by zero during the final division.]
        [LOG "Division by zero occurs while computing BMI from weight and height squared."]
        [THROW ZeroDivisionError "Raised when the height value is zero."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
FitnessTracker.condition_judge:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "This method computes a BMI value, selects the appropriate BMI range based on sex, and returns 1, -1, or 0 depending on whether the BMI is above, below, or within that range." condition_judge]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing get_BMI(), sex, and BMI_std."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "1 if BMI is above the upper bound, -1 if below the lower bound, otherwise 0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.get_BMI() and store the returned value in BMI. RESULT BMI]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.sex is exactly "male"; if it is, select self.BMI_std[0]["male"] as BMI_range, otherwise select self.BMI_std[1]["female"]. RESULT BMI_range]
            [COMMAND Compare BMI against BMI_range[1]; if BMI is strictly greater than the upper bound, return 1 to indicate the BMI is too high. RESULT 1]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, compare BMI against BMI_range[0]; if BMI is strictly less than the lower bound, return -1 to indicate the BMI is too low. RESULT -1]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, return 0 to indicate the BMI is within the inclusive range from BMI_range[0] to BMI_range[1]. RESULT 0]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
FitnessTracker.calculate_calorie_intake:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Calculate a calorie intake estimate by computing BMR from sex, weight, height, and age, then applying an activity-based multiplier." calculate_calorie_intake]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing sex, weight, height, age, and a condition_judge method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The calculated calorie intake value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.sex is equal to "male". RESULT sex_check]
            [COMMAND If self.sex is "male", compute BMR as 10 * self.weight + 6.25 * self.height - 5 * self.age + 5; otherwise compute BMR as 10 * self.weight + 6.25 * self.height - 5 * self.age - 161. RESULT BMR]
            [COMMAND Evaluate self.condition_judge() for the first activity classification test. RESULT condition_value]
            [COMMAND If self.condition_judge() equals 1, set calorie_intake to BMR * 1.2. RESULT calorie_intake]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, evaluate self.condition_judge() again for the second activity classification test. RESULT condition_value]
            [COMMAND If self.condition_judge() equals -1, set calorie_intake to BMR * 1.6; otherwise set calorie_intake to BMR * 1.4. RESULT calorie_intake]
            [COMMAND Return calorie_intake. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
